messages:
sam_platform: follow-up from the NOVA-HEALTH private cluster outage this AM. short cause recap: BGP hold-time asymmetry caused route table drift after peering flaps + our agent v2.3.1 reapplied isolation rules too eagerly. adding concrete remediation items below. pls claim.

anya_prod: ouch. timeline for a customer-safe rollback or hotfix? they want a Friday window if possible.

leo_sre: i'll take the BGP/route work. immediate plan: 1) add explicit route reconciliation on peering up (call out: run `redwoodctl net reconcile --peer <id>`), 2) tighten peering monitor to surface hold-time mismatch metrics, 3) add an e2e test in staging that simulates hold-time variance. ETA: hotfix scheduled for 48h, e2e next sprint. assigning INC-2026-462 to myself.

carmen_ops: i'll coordinate the rollback playbook and org-runbook updates. suggest a canary rollback to the last stable agent (v2.2.8) for affected private clusters while hotfix ships. canary plan: 1 cluster first.

oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-462 | severity: high | owner: leo_sre | status: triage

leo_sre: isolation enforcement bug detail: agent state machine moves to STRICT once it detects peer deletion; if peer flaps quickly we transition twice and don't validate route convergence before applying strict ACLs. quick mitigation: add a convergence check and a 45s grace window after peer-up before applying STRICT. will expose `isolation_grace_seconds` config (default 45). ETA for mitigation config change: EOD tomorrow.

sam_platform: good. please make the config toggle visible in the Private Console and default to safe mode. customers with compliance reasons can opt into faster enforcement.

anya_prod: i'll run a config inventory across private installs for non-default `isolation_grace_seconds` or manual STRICT opt-ins. report in 12h.

leo_sre: inventory result: 2 installs have manual STRICT opt-in (NOVA-HEALTH, RURALMED). flagging NOVA-HEALTH as impacted and RURALMED as medium risk.

carmen_ops: i've scheduled a customer sync with NOVA-HEALTH infra lead tomorrow 09:30 PT. will propose canary rollback and mitigation timeline.

sam_platform: action list (please confirm ownership & ETA):
- leo_sre: implement route reconcile + peering hold-time metrics + `redwoodctl` hook (ETA: 48h hotfix)
- leo_sre: add 45s convergence check + `isolation_grace_seconds` config (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- carmen_ops: run canary rollback to v2.2.8 for one cluster and validate (ETA: before hotfix)
- anya_prod: inventory of non-default isolation configs and report (ETA: 12h)
- sam_platform: add UI toggle for `isolation_grace_seconds` in Private Console and update docs (ETA: next week)

leo_sre: also noting recurring pattern: this is the third peering-related isolation incident in 7 months. propose a monthly incident trend ticket and RFC for proactive route reconciliation in the runtime. i'll open the RFC and include cost/ops impact.

anya_prod: agree — add cross-team follow-up to product roadmap discussion. we should weigh complexity vs. reliability gains.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-462 updated | owner: leo_sre | status: in-progress

carmen_ops: customer comms draft: "we identified a peering route convergence bug coupled with agent enforcement timing. mitigation: we will perform a canary rollback and ship a soft-config mitigation; full fix to follow. expected timeline: canary within 24h, mitigation config within 48h, permanent fix in next sprint." i'll paste official text here after legal review.

sam_platform: please add these to the incident ticket: PRs, canary runbook, customer comms, and test results. i'll check progress during next incident triage. thanks all. :pray:
